keyEvents.text: Goal! NEC 0, PSV Eindhoven 1. Filip Kostic (PSV Eindhoven) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sven Mijnans.
Mitchel Bakker (NEC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! NEC 0, PSV Eindhoven 2. Ivan Perisic (PSV Eindhoven) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Mauro Júnior (PSV Eindhoven).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Noah Fernandez replaces Mauro Júnior because of an injury.
Own Goal by Ahmetcan Kaplan, NEC. NEC 0, PSV Eindhoven 3.
First Half ends, NEC 0, PSV Eindhoven 3.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Kiliann Sildillia replaces Sergiño Dest.
Second Half begins NEC 0, PSV Eindhoven 3.
Noah Fernandez (PSV Eindhoven) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Guus Til (PSV Eindhoven) is shown the yellow card.
Ahmetcan Kaplan (NEC) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! NEC 0, PSV Eindhoven 4. Ruben van Bommel (PSV Eindhoven) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Guus Til following a fast break.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Esmir Bajraktarevic replaces Ivan Perisic.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ayoni Santos replaces Ruben van Bommel.
Filip Kostic (PSV Eindhoven) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, NEC. Tobias Storm replaces Tjaronn Chery.
Substitution, NEC. Dennis Geiger replaces Gabriel Brás.
Substitution, NEC. Willum Willumsson replaces Darko Nejasmic.
Substitution, NEC. Clement Bischoff replaces Deveron Fonville.
Substitution, NEC. Kaj Sierhuis replaces Kevin Kers.
Goal! NEC 1, PSV Eindhoven 4. Bryan Linssen (NEC) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner.
Substitution, PSV Eindhoven. Ricardo Pepi replaces Guus Til.
